title: Bram and the Ember
author: Sebastian Coldharbour
blurb: Emrys Galloway, an exiled storm-caller, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
